Sandbox_DCD_CourtChance_tooltip: Chance for each card in a pack to be a court card (Jack, Queen or King, which carry a race) instead of an Ace or a 2-10. Every card in a pack rolls on its own.
Sandbox_DCD_StandardWeight_tooltip: Relative weight for a card rolling Standard, the common suit-coloured print. Weights are compared against each other, so 70 / 20 / 8 / 2 means 70% Standard, 20% Bronze, 8% Silver, 2% Gold.
Sandbox_DCD_BronzeWeight_tooltip: Relative weight for a card rolling Bronze.
Sandbox_DCD_SilverWeight_tooltip: Relative weight for a card rolling Silver.
Sandbox_DCD_GoldWeight_tooltip: Relative weight for a card rolling Gold.
Sandbox_DCD_RaceWeightHuman_tooltip: Relative weight for a court card being Human. The four race weights are compared against each other.
Sandbox_DCD_RaceWeightGoblin_tooltip: Relative weight for a court card being Goblin.
Sandbox_DCD_RaceWeightElf_tooltip: Relative weight for a court card being Elf.
Sandbox_DCD_RaceWeightDwarf_tooltip: Relative weight for a court card being Dwarf.
Sandbox_DCD_PackLootWeight_tooltip: Multiplies how often card packs spawn in dressers, desks, toy and hobby shops. 0 turns world spawns off.
Sandbox_DCD_ZombieDropChance_tooltip: Chance for a killed zombie to carry a card pack. 0 turns zombie drops off.
